title: Adding a New Admin in the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners

blocks.text: Zscaler partners can create admin users with different permissions to manage intended tenants or tenant groups on the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners.
To add a new admin user:

blocks.item: Go to Admins and click Add Admin.

Login ID: Enter a login ID for the admin user. Select a domain name from the list of domains configured for your organization. A unique login ID is created for the admin in an email format with the information that you provide here.
Admin Name: Enter a name for the admin to be associated with the login ID.
Email ID: Enter the email ID of the admin user.
Role: Select a role template for the admin.
Tenants: Select tenants from the respective cloud.
Comments: Enter additional notes or information. The description cannot exceed 10,240 characters.
Password: Enter the password to be set for the login ID.
Confirm Password: Retype the password for confirmation.
